projects.title: Criminal Network Analysis
projects.description: Built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH). Problem: Law enforcement agencies struggle to map and disrupt criminal networks from fragmented data. Approach: Graph-based network analysis pipeline using relationship mapping, entity extraction from case reports, and pattern detection to surface hidden connections between criminal actors, organizations, and events.

projects.title: LegalMind AI
projects.description: Problem: Lawyers spend hours manually hunting through past judgments to find relevant citations and build solid case arguments. Approach: AI-powered legal assistant that extracts citations from uploaded judgments, surfaces related precedents, and helps lawyers construct stronger case laws using RAG over a legal document corpus.

projects.title: Fake News Classifier
projects.description: Problem: Rampant misinformation spread across digital media. Approach: Fine-tuned RoBERTa transformer paired with Ollama local LLM verification, deployed with FastAPI backend and React frontend. Result: 94.2% classification accuracy with transparent reasoning.

projects.title: KnightSight EdgeVision
projects.description: Problem: License plate recognition failures under low-light edge constraints. Approach: Ultra-lightweight YOLOv11 detector (2.6M params), dual OCR, and ONNX Runtime acceleration. Result: 99.49% mAP@50 at 45 FPS on low-power hardware.

projects.title: Penguin Classifier
projects.description: Problem: Rapid morphological species identification in environmental research. Approach: Scikit-learn classification pipeline with feature analysis and interactive Streamlit UI. Result: 98.7% test accuracy on the Palmer Archipelago dataset.

projects.title: Dean Career Cloud Platform
projects.description: Problem: Fragmented career resources and lack of centralized placement architecture for SCSET engineering students. Approach: Architected official career forum portal featuring specialized cohort tracks, 1-on-1 MAANG mentorship pipelines, and real-time query desks. Result: Shipped to production at dcc-wesbite.vercel.app serving university-wide placement cohorts.
